title: Hello and Goodbye — First Words and Sounds
objectives: Greet and take leave with hello/hi/goodbye/bye; introduce yourself with I am + name; address a pictured person with You are + name.
notes: P-01: complete picture-led draft; author and automated audits only; independent review/validation and learner testing pending. Eight words; G003 supports the single main I am/You are name frame. Listening is a helper-read script, not recorded audio.

title: Hello and Goodbye — Grammar Foundations
objectives: Refer to the speaker's and listener's name with my/your; use My name is/Your name is + name; ask What is your name? as a fixed chunk and answer it.
notes: P-01: complete picture-led draft; author and automated audits only; independent review/validation and learner testing pending. Five words, including explicitly advanced what/is. G011 is my/your + name only; G010 is the fixed name question only, not the productive wh-question system.
